items.title: Logistic growth
items.sutra: घातः २ खः घातांकः सङ्कलनस्य २ १ घातः २ घातांकः ळचखस्य घातेन ३ ऋणम् १ तः रः सङ्कलनम् २ ऋणम् १ घातः २ खः घातांकः णस्य ऋणम् १ ऋणम् १
items.declarations: प्रकरणम् खः ळञख तः ळञख रः ळञख णः ळञख ।
items.gloss_en: K divided by the sum of 1 and the product of the power, with exponent minus the product of t and r, of e and the sum of minus 1 and K divided by N
items.meaning: Population growing to a carrying capacity in an S-shaped curve.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: Michaelis-Menten rate
items.sutra: घातः ३ ववकः शः घातांकः सङ्कलनस्य २ खः शः ऋणम् १
items.declarations: प्रकरणम् ववकः ळञख शः ळञख खः ळञख ।
items.gloss_en: the product of V, S and the reciprocal of the sum of K and S
items.units: rate units; S and K same concentration unit
items.meaning: Enzyme reaction rate saturating at V.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: Hill equation, n = 2
items.sutra: घातः २ घातांकः शस्य २ घातांकः सङ्कलनस्य २ घातांकः खस्य २ घातांकः शस्य २ ऋणम् १
items.gloss_en: the square of S divided by the sum of the square of K and the square of S
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: Gompertz growth
items.sutra: घातः २ खः घातांकः ळचखस्य घातेन ३ ऋणम् १ बः घातांकः ळचखस्य घातेन ३ ऋणम् १ चः तः
items.declarations: प्रकरणम् खः ळञख बः ळञख चः ळञख तः ळञख ।
items.gloss_en: the product of K and the power, with exponent minus the product of b and the power, with exponent minus the product of c and t, of e, of e
items.units: K in population units; c in 1/time
items.meaning: Asymmetric sigmoid growth used for tumours and populations.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: Hardy-Weinberg heterozygotes
items.sutra: घातः ३ २ पः सङ्कलनम् २ १ घातः २ ऋणम् १ पः
items.gloss_en: the product of 2, p and the sum of 1 and minus p
items.meaning: Expected heterozygote frequency 2 p (1-p) in an ideal population.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling

items.title: Exponential growth
items.sutra: घातः २ णः घातांकः ळचखस्य घातेन २ तः रः
items.declarations: प्रकरणम् णः ळञख तः ळञख रः ळञख ।
items.gloss_en: the product of N and the power, with exponent the product of t and r, of e
items.meaning: Unbounded growth at a constant relative rate.
items.status: physical commentary illustrative, not engine-verified; title is a proposal pending owner ruling
